notes.title: New Release
notes.notes:
"Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded-" is just launched on Steam!
Whether you have been waiting for the release of the game or you happened to come across it, we hope you enjoy the massive amount of fun features. You could play forever!
We would appreciate any comments about this game, and we'll keep on going with releasing updates! 
Enjoy your time with "Touhou Genso Wanderer -Reloaded-"!
